protocol.candidates: 31 original-direction candidates; 300 initial CEM samples plus all 18 archived first plans

arms.structured: repeat the original five-step block along its query direction
arms.issued: native CEM raw commands; simulator applies its native clipping
arms.clipped: same physical futures as issued; clip only future model inputs to [-1,1]
arms.small: scale clipped actions by 0.525 for both model and simulation

protocol.comparison: all checkpoints and histories score the same saved candidates and goals
protocol.selection: evaluation_index=0 in each of the six Development seeds, no performance filtering
protocol.state_observation: physical state used only by simulator and scorer; predictor sees images and actions

definitions.prediction_error_ratio: sum squared prediction error / sum squared error of persisting current encoded frame; 0 perfect,1 persistence
definitions.response_score: 100*(1-response squared error/true response energy), pooled over speed pairs and candidates
definitions.regret: physical candidate regret in pixels, averaged over speeds then scenes
definitions.oracle_distance: distance of best candidate; candidate coverage differs across action banks
definitions.context_value: min_k mean_speed J_speed(k) - mean_speed min_k J_speed(k); physical value of conditioning an otherwise optimal candidate choice, not an upper bound on model history gain

coverage: diagnostic on six fixed Development scenes; not a closed-loop intervention
